name: canvas
title: Canvas
description: A zoomable workflow canvas showing trigger, agent and tool steps connected by thin lines. Scrolling pans the field and clicking a node selects it.
use: You need to show or edit a pipeline of steps as connected nodes on a pannable field.
avoid: Node text is tiny and low contrast on the dark field, and the canvas is mostly empty space.
a11y: The workflow is mouse-driven; node cards have no roles or names, and the animated edges ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black full-screen field holds five small bordered cards laid out left to right and branching. Each card has a tiny category, a title and a dim detail line, joined by faint curved connectors.
behaves: The whole graph pans when the user scrolls, and dragging across empty space draws a selection box. Clicking a node adds a highlight ring around it.
customise: Nodes, edges and node types arrive as arrays and components; panning, zoom and selection are passed through to the flow engine.
weight: moderate: A third-party flow engine renders a pannable canvas with five nodes and SVG edges.
